toolCalls.input: {"persuasiveness":6,"perceivedCorrectness":82,"actionability":6,"reason":"The brief backs up its interaction claim with a bench test covering all four firmware and film combinations, plus a natural control group on the floor (the 6.3 units and the Zone C tote robots both stayed flat), which knocks out the temps theory and the firmware-only theory; it also gives clear next steps, though it doesn't say how to handle 6.3's security support ending on 31 October or whether matte film affects throughput."}

output.reason: The brief backs up its interaction claim with a bench test covering all four firmware and film combinations, plus a natural control group on the floor (the 6.3 units and the Zone C tote robots both stayed flat), which knocks out the temps theory and the firmware-only theory; it also gives clear next steps, though it doesn't say how to handle 6.3's security support ending on 31 October or whether matte film affects throughput.
